nodes.description: Public SpaceportInfo struct holding owner, sale/base tokens, price, caps, listing rate, blocks and lock period.
Public SpaceportStatus struct holding whitelist flag, LP completion flag, force-fail flag and aggregate raised/sold/withdrawn counters.
Address authorised to initialise the spaceport (init1/init2).
Privileged dev address allowed to force-fail the spaceport.
Mapping of participant address to BuyerInfo (baseDeposited, tokensOwed, vesting state).
EnumerableSet of whitelisted participant addresses.
Public vesting cliff and vesting end timestamps.
Public fee configuration: base/token fee rates and fee recipient addresses.
External lock forwarder used to add and lock plasmaSwap liquidity.
External settings contract providing round length, fees and spaceport length.
Initialises economic parameters of the spaceport; restricted to SPACEPORT_GENERATOR.
Initialises tokens, fee info and vesting parameters; restricted to SPACEPORT_GENERATOR.
View computing spaceport state (0 queued, 1 active, 2 success, 3 failed).
Payable nonReentrant deposit of ETH or base ERC20 tokens into the spaceport.
NonReentrant percentile-based withdrawal of sale tokens with vesting logic.
NonReentrant refund of contributed base tokens when the spaceport failed.
Spaceport owner reclaims sale tokens left in the contract after failure.
Anyone can force-fail the spaceport if a plasmaSwap pair already holds the sale token.
Allows PLFI_DEV_ADDRESS to force-fail the spaceport.
Final nonReentrant step: pays fees, burns unsold tokens, locks liquidity and enables withdrawals.
Spaceport owner updates the per-buyer spend cap.
Spaceport owner updates start/end blocks, bounded by max spaceport length.
Spaceport owner toggles the whitelist-only flag.
Spaceport owner adds or removes users from the whitelist.
View returning whether an address is whitelisted.
View returning the whitelisted address at an index.
View returning the number of whitelisted addresses.
Caller-controlled address used for authorisation, buyer lookup and fund transfers.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for vesting and lock period calculations.
External call pulling base ERC20 tokens from the buyer in userDeposit.
ETH refund sent to msg.sender via transfer when the deposit exceeds the allowance.
External call sending sale tokens to the withdrawing buyer.
External call refunding ETH or base ERC20 tokens to the buyer after failure.
External call to SPACEPORT_LOCK_FORWARDER.lockLiquidity with approvals already granted.
Unchecked subtraction HARDCAP - TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED computing remaining raise capacity.
Unchecked timestamp arithmetic (block.timestamp - buyer.lastUpdate) driving vested amounts.
External call sending all remaining sale tokens to the spaceport owner on failure.
External base/token fee transfers to fee addresses and unsold token burn inside addLiquidity.
Timestamp-dependent unlock date block.timestamp + LOCK_PERIOD passed to lockLiquidity.
ERC20 base amount supplied to userDeposit.
UserDeposit effective deposit amount after allowance capping.
UserDeposit tokens owed derived from amount_in and TOKEN_PRICE.
UserDeposit per-buyer allowance capped by remaining hardcap.
UserWithdrawTokens denominator TOTAL_TOKENS_SOLD - TOTAL_TOKENS_WITHDRAWN.
UserWithdrawTokens amount of sale tokens computed for the caller.
UserWithdrawBaseTokens denominator TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED - TOTAL_BASE_WITHDRAWN.
New start block passed to updateBlocks.
New end block passed to updateBlocks.
Array of addresses added to or removed from the whitelist in editWhitelist.
UserWithdrawBaseTokens refund amount computed for the caller.

edges.reason: init1 requires msg.sender to equal SPACEPORT_GENERATOR before writing configuration.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is compared against SPACEPORT_GENERATOR in init1.
init1 writes owner, amount, price, caps, blocks and lock period into SPACEPORT_INFO.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is checked against SPACEPORT_GENERATOR in init2.
init2 writes token configuration and SPACEPORT_IN_ETH flag into SPACEPORT_INFO.
init2 writes fee rates and fee addresses into SPACEPORT_FEE_INFO.
init2 writes vesting cliff and vesting end into SPACEPORT_VESTING.
init2 calls SPACEPORT_SETTINGS.getRound1Length().
Round1 length read from settings is stored in STATUS.ROUND1_LENGTH.
spaceportStatus branches on STATUS flags and total collected amounts.
spaceportStatus reads END_BLOCK, SOFTCAP, HARDCAP and START_BLOCK from SPACEPORT_INFO.
userDeposit requires spaceportStatus() == 1 before accepting funds.
msg.sender selects the BuyerInfo entry and receives refunds in userDeposit.
userDeposit reads and updates BUYERS[msg.sender] deposit and token balances.
userDeposit reads MAX_SPEND_PER_BUYER, HARDCAP, TOKEN_PRICE and token addresses.
userDeposit updates NUM_BUYERS, TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED and TOTAL_TOKENS_SOLD in STATUS.
_amount is used as amount_in for non-ETH spaceports.
amount_in is multiplied by TOKEN_PRICE and divided by token decimals to produce tokensSold.
userDeposit computes remaining = HARDCAP - TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED without SafeMath.
STATUS.TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED feeds the unchecked subtraction of the remaining hardcap.
SPACEPORT_INFO.HARDCAP feeds the unchecked subtraction of the remaining hardcap.
The remaining amount computed from the unchecked subtraction caps amount_in.
The per-buyer allowance caps amount_in before token accounting.
userDeposit calls TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom to pull base ERC20 tokens.
amount_in is passed as the value of the safeTransferFrom base token call.
userDeposit sends an ETH refund to msg.sender via transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH refund transfer.
msg.value.sub(amount_in) determines the refunded ETH amount.
userWithdrawTokens reads and updates TOTAL_TOKENS_SOLD/TOTAL_TOKENS_WITHDRAWN.
msg.sender selects the buyer record used for withdrawal calculations.
BUYERS[msg.sender] vesting fields drive the token withdrawal math.
block.timestamp is compared with vesting cliff and vesting end to gate withdrawals.
userWithdrawTokens computes block.timestamp - buyer.lastUpdate without SafeMath.
block.timestamp feeds the unchecked vesting elapsed-time arithmetic.
userWithdrawTokens calls TransferHelper.safeTransfer for the sale token.
Computed tokensOwed is the value transferred to the withdrawing buyer.
tokensOwed is derived by dividing token balance by tokensRemainingDenominator.
userWithdrawTokens reads S_TOKEN and balance information from SPACEPORT_INFO.
userWithdrawBaseTokens requires spaceportStatus() == 3 (failed).
msg.sender selects the buyer record and receives the refund transfer.
buyer.baseDeposited is read, zeroed and added to TOTAL_BASE_WITHDRAWN.
TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED and TOTAL_BASE_WITHDRAWN feed the refund denominator.
baseRemainingDenominator is computed from STATUS counters inside the function.
tokensOwed is computed as remaining balance multiplied by baseDeposited divided by the denominator.
userWithdrawBaseTokens calls safeTransferBaseToken to refund ETH or base tokens.
Computed refund amount tokensOwed is passed to the base token transfer.
userWithdrawBaseTokens reads SPACEPORT_IN_ETH and B_TOKEN from SPACEPORT_INFO.
ownerWithdrawTokens is guarded by onlySpaceportOwner comparing SPACEPORT_OWNER to the caller.
msg.sender must equal SPACEPORT_INFO.SPACEPORT_OWNER to withdraw.
ownerWithdrawTokens requires spaceportStatus() == 3.
ownerWithdrawTokens calls TransferHelper.safeTransfer for the sale token.
S_TOKEN address and owner address determine the recipient of the token transfer.
forceFailIfPairExists calls SPACEPORT_LOCK_FORWARDER.plasmaswapPairIsInitialised.
The pair check result sets STATUS.FORCE_FAILED.
forceFailByPlfi requires msg.sender == PLFI_DEV_ADDRESS.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is compared against PLFI_DEV_ADDRESS.
forceFailByPlfi writes STATUS.FORCE_FAILED, changing spaceport outcome for all users.
addLiquidity reads and sets LP_GENERATION_COMPLETE and related STATUS fields.
addLiquidity requires spaceportStatus() == 2 before generating liquidity.
addLiquidity queries SPACEPORT_LOCK_FORWARDER.plasmaswapPairIsInitialised.
addLiquidity performs the external lockLiquidity call.
TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED and TOTAL_TOKENS_SOLD determine the liquidity amounts locked.
addLiquidity performs fee transfers and the unsold token burn.
Fee addresses, token addresses and liquidity percent feed the fee transfer amounts.
addLiquidity builds the unlock date from the timestamp before locking liquidity.
block.timestamp is added to LOCK_PERIOD to derive the liquidity unlock date.
updateMaxSpendLimit is modifier-guarded by onlySpaceportOwner.
msg.sender must be the spaceport owner to change MAX_SPEND_PER_BUYER.
updateBlocks calls SPACEPORT_SETTINGS.getMaxSpaceportLength().
updateBlocks writes START_BLOCK and END_BLOCK into SPACEPORT_INFO.
_startBlock is validated and assigned to SPACEPORT_INFO.START_BLOCK.
_endBlock is validated and assigned to SPACEPORT_INFO.END_BLOCK.
msg.sender must be the spaceport owner to reschedule the spaceport.
setWhitelistFlag writes STATUS.WHITELIST_ONLY under owner-only control.
msg.sender must be the spaceport owner to toggle the whitelist flag.
editWhitelist adds or removes addresses in the WHITELIST set under owner-only control.
_users array entries are iterated and inserted into or removed from the whitelist.
msg.sender must be the spaceport owner to edit the whitelist.
getUserWhitelistStatus reads WHITELIST.contains(_user).
getWhitelistedUserAtIndex reads WHITELIST.at(_index).
getWhitelistedUsersLength reads WHITELIST.length().

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _amount only supplies the deposit amount consumed by userDeposit.
Local amount_in is the value forwarded to the external safeTransferFrom call.
Local tokensSold exists only inside userDeposit accounting.
Local allowance is produced by the unchecked remaining-cap subtraction logic.
Local tokensRemainingDenominator is only used in userWithdrawTokens math.
Local tokensOwed is the amount forwarded to the sale token safeTransfer.
Local baseRemainingDenominator exists only inside userWithdrawBaseTokens.
Parameter _startBlock is consumed only by updateBlocks.
Parameter _endBlock is consumed only by updateBlocks.
Parameter _users is consumed only by editWhitelist.
Local tokensOwedBase is the amount forwarded to the base token refund transfer.
